title: Kallostide
body:
"A fighting chance. A fighting feel"


The Kallostide is an item that can be purchased from Fungi Finds for $8,400. It is a decorative mask on a stand.

Appearance

The Kallostide is a featureless mask with two holes in the place of eyes, placed upon an angled stand. When unboxed, the Kallostide picks one of five random colors (yellow, blue, red, green, and brown) and one of four different materials (metal, foil, bricks, and granite), resulting in 20 potential combinations.

Trivia

  • This item was made by a contributor by the name of Duogon.
